game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: link2309
quote:
After 17 years of being a gamer and having the experience of this industry from knowing how they treat consumers, it’s clear GTA 6 completely forgot what made the franchise great. Gameplay is like salt—without it, the whole dish is ruined. Rockstar traded pure arcade fun for tedious hyper-realism: limiting weapon carrying to a car trunk, forcing gun-free "safe zones" inside clubs, and punishing classic open-world chaos with a hidden morality meter. Anyone who knew how they treated GTA online and have experience from the other GTA games, have experience to know what was coming, and people like me called it before it's release

Instead of innovating, it feels like a recycled mashup—mixing RDR2's slow restrictions, a cheap knockoff of San Andreas’s Officer Tenpenny (Mendez), and a bleak Bonnie-and-Clyde story with unrewarding endings and a time-loop post-game. People only defend this because of FOMO and Rockstar's past reputation. It is nowhere near worth $80+—wait until the next console generation and grab it in the $20–$30 bargain bin where it belongs. I'm glad i save up on this. Atrocious game, anyone rating this highly is purely coping lol

Moral: Never buy a game based the company's past reputation, graphics over gameplay or the hype folks create around it. If you want it always wait for the price to go down, coz it's all about quality per value at the end of the day to avoid losses. FOMO is a gimmick
